title: MS-PAVED - Platform for Connectivity, Trust, Experience, and Documentation
summary: Through the "MS-PAVED" study, we aim to better understand the experiences and needs of people with multiple sclerosis (MS) in their daily lives. To this end, in addition to the usual medical questions, we will also ask about quality of life and lifestyle. At the same time, we aim to evaluate the extent to which patient self-reporting via a documentation portal is accepted by people with MS, in MS research, and by the patients themselves.

interventions.name: Basic Questionnaire: Information on subjective well-being, sociodemographic data (e.g., gender, age, region of residence), initial disease-related information (e.g., onset and diagnosis date of MS, course of the disease, PDDS, symptoms, immunotherapy, relapses), information on sources of information

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Medically diagnosed multiple sclerosis (self-reported)
- Willingness and ability to participate in the survey independently
Exclusion criteria:
- No multiple sclerosis (self-reported)
- Lack of legal capacity
